critical_healthcare_facilities.name: District Area Hospital Kamareddy
critical_healthcare_facilities.location: Near Railway Station / Subhash Nagar, Kamareddy
critical_healthcare_facilities.capacity: 300 beds with ICU, anti-snake venom (ASV), trauma unit, backup generator on elevated plinth.

high_ground_shelters.name: Kamareddy Municipal High School & Indoor Complex
high_ground_shelters.amenities: Generator, drinking water tanks, kitchen, separate sanitation.

high_ground_shelters.name: Government Degree College Kamareddy
high_ground_shelters.amenities: Helipad clearance on sports ground, large hall, medical station.

critical_waterbodies_and_catchments.name: Pocharam Reservoir & Dam
critical_waterbodies_and_catchments.impact: Excess discharge causes backwater flooding in Nagireddypet and downstream lowlands.

critical_waterbodies_and_catchments.name: Kaulas Nala Project
critical_waterbodies_and_catchments.impact: Surge flooding in Jukkal and Bichkunda low-lying agricultural zones.

critical_waterbodies_and_catchments.name: Bikanur Big Tank (Pedda Cheruvu)
critical_waterbodies_and_catchments.impact: Breach risk threatens NH-44 culverts and Bikanur rail bridge approaches.

flood_vulnerable_corridors: NH-44 Hyderabad-Nagpur Highway low culverts near Tekrial and Bikanur
Kamareddy-Sircilla Road causeways across local seasonal streams
Nagireddypet mandal riverside hamlets near Pocharam canal outflow
Railway underpasses in Kamareddy municipal limits (Subhash Nagar, Old Town)
